newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Chrysler cars to be assembled in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler cars to be assembled in Philippines.

text.p: Chrysler Corp has agreed on a partnership with a Philippine firm to assemble cars and jeeps in the country, Melito Salazar, head of the Philippine Board of Investments, said on Friday.
Chrysler will assemble its Neon and Stratus cars and Jeep Cherokee at a plant in Cebu in the central Philippines in a venture with local firm Transfarm & Co Inc, Salazar told reporters.
"This will serve as a market test for their (Chrysler's) future expansion (in the Philippines)," he said.
Board of Investments officials said Chrysler planned to invest in the Cebu plant but it would depend on how the cars were received in the market.
The Transfarm-Chrysler venture hopes to sell this year 1,000 Cherokees, 600 units of Neon and 500 units of Stratus, the officials said.
